descriere: Sets the scaling for the acceleration pre-control of the speed/velocity controller.
Sets the scaling for the acceleration integrator at low speeds (only for encoderless torque control).

Sets the source for the torque setpoint. For single-digit values, the following applies: The value specifies the main setpoint. For double-digit values, the following applies: The left-hand digit specifies the supplementary setpoint, the right-hand digit the main setpoint.

descriere_scurta: Change over between closed-loop speed/torque control
descriere: Sets the signal source for toggling between speed and torque control.
Sets the signal source for the torque setpoint for torque control.
Sets the signal source for scaling the supplementary torque 1.
Sets the signal source for supplementary torque 2.
Sets the scaling for supplementary torque 2.
Sets the smoothing time constant of the accelerating torque.
Displays the accelerating torque for pre-control of the speed controller. Index: [0] = Unsmoothed [1] = Smoothed
Sets the fixed, lower torque limit.
Sets the signal source for the lower torque limit.
Sets the scaling for the upper torque limit or the torque limit when motoring.

Sets the signal source for the scaling of the upper torque limit in p1522. Danger: For p1400.4 = 0 (torque limiting, upper/lower) the following applies: Negative values resulting from the signal source and scaling can cause the motor to accelerate in an uncontrolled manner.

Sets the signal source for the scaling of the lower torque limit in p1523. Danger: For p1400.4 = 0 (torque limiting, upper/lower) the following applies: Positive values resulting from the signal source and scaling can cause the motor to accelerate in an uncontrolled manner.
Sets the power limit when motoring.

Displays the limit for the torque-generating current component using the stall calculation, the current limit of the power unit as well as the parameterization in p0640. Index: [0] = Upper limit [1] = Lower limit

descriere_scurta: Torque limit upper scaling without offset
descriere: Sets the signal source for the scaling of the upper torque limiting to limit the speed controller output without taking into account the current and power limits.

Sets the scaling of the stall limit for the start of field weakening. Danger: If the stall current limit is increased, then the q current setpoint can exceed the stall limit; as a consequence, a hys- teresis effect can occur when loading and unloading.

descriere_scurta: Torque limit lower scaling without offset
descriere: Sets the signal source for the scaling of the lower torque limiting to limit the speed controller output without taking into account the current and power limits.
Sets the flux setpoint referred to rated motor flux.
Sets the flux threshold value for enabling the speed setpoint and the end of magnetizing (r0056.4).
Sets a dynamic voltage reserve.

Sets the efficiency optimization. When optimizing the efficiency, the flux setpoint of the closed-loop control is adapted as a function of the load. For p1580 = 100 %, under no-load operating conditions, the flux setpoint is reduced to 50 % of the rated motor flux.

descriere_scurta: Field weakening operation flux setpoint smoothing time
descriere: Sets the smoothing time for the flux setpoint in the field-weakening range

descriere_scurta: Field weakening controller / flux controller output
descriere: Display and connector output for the output of the field weakening controller (synchronous motor). Index: [0] = PI output [1] = I output
Sets the P gain of the field-weakening controller.
Sets the integral-action time of the field-weakening controller.
Enters the dynamic torque setpoint for the low-speed range for sensorless vector control (SLVC). This parameter is entered as a percentage referred to the rated motor torque (r0333).
Sets the smoothing time for the current setpoint. The current setpoint is generated from p1610 and p1611.
Displays the steady-state field generating current setpoint (Id_set).

descriere_scurta: Curr. setpoint torque-gen. smoothing time field weakening range
descriere: Sets the smoothing time constant for the setpoint of the torque-generating current components.
Sets the scaling of the dynamic current controller pre-control for the flux-generating current component Isd.
Sets the scaling of the dynamic current controller pre-control for the torque/force-generating current component Isq.
Sets the proportional gain of the current controller. This value is automatically pre-set using p3900 or p0340 when commissioning has been completed.
Sets the integral-action time of the current controller.
Sets the scaling of the quadrature arm decoupling

descriere_scurta: Quadrature arm decoupling at voltage limit scaling
descriere: Sets the scaling of quadrature arm decoupling when the voltage limit is reached.

descriere_scurta: Isd controller integral component shutdown threshold
descriere: Sets the speed threshold for deactivating the integral component of the Isd controller. The d current controller is only effective as P controller for speeds greater than the threshold value. Instead of the integral component, the quadrature arm decoupling is effective.

descriere_scurta: Isd controller combination current time component
descriere: Sets the time constant to calculate the d current DC component difference (combination current) to add to the d cur- rent controller actual value. The additional input is de-activated with p1731 = 0.
Displays the direct-axis voltage setpoint Ud. Index: [0] = Unsmoothed [1] = Smoothed with p0045
Displays the quadrature-axis component of voltage setpoint Uq. Index: [0] = Unsmoothed [1] = Smoothed with p0045

descriere_scurta: Gain resonance damping for encoderless closed-loop control
descriere: Defines the gain of the controller for resonance damping for operation with sensorless vector control in the range that current is injected.

descriere_scurta: Motor model error threshold stall detection
descriere: Sets the fault threshold in order to detect a motor that has stalled. If the error signal (r1746) exceeds the parameterized error threshold, then status signal r1408.12 is set to 1.

descriere_scurta: Motor model increase changeover speed encoderless operation
descriere: Minimum operating frequency for rugged operation. If the minimum value is greater than the lower changeover limit parameterized with p1755 * (1 - 2 * p1756), then the difference is displayed using p1749 * p1755. The parameter value cannot be changed.

Sets the configuration for the motor model. Bit 0 = 1: Forces open-loop speed-controlled starting (ASM). Bit 1 = 1: Forces the system to pass through frequency zero, open-loop-controlled (ASM). Bit 2 = 1: Drive remains in full closed-loop control mode, even at zero frequency (ASM). Bit 3 = 1: Motor model evaluates the saturation characteristic (ASM). Bit 6 = 1: If the motor is blocked, sensorless vector control remains speed-controlled (ASM). Bit 7 = 1: Use rugged switchover limits to switchover the model (open-loop/closed-loop controlled) for regenerative operation (ASM).

descriere_scurta: Motor model changeover delay time closed/open-loop control
descriere: Sets the minimum time for falling below the changeover speed when changing from closed-loop controlled opera- tion to open-loop controlled operation.

descriere_scurta: Motor model changeover delay time open/closed-loop control
descriere: Sets the minimum time for a transition from open-loop controlled to closed-loop controlled operation after the lower changeover speed p1755 * (1 - p1756 / 100 %) has been exceeded.

Induction motor (ASM): Displays the referred imaginary system deviation for the adaptation circuit of the motor model. Permanent magnet synchronous motor (PEM): Displays the system deviation for speed adaptation. r1762[0]: Angular deviation [rad-el] of the estimated EMF. r1762[1]: Angular deviation [rad-el] of the low-level signal response for pulse technique. Index: [0] = Deviation model 1 [1] = Deviation model 2

descriere_scurta: Motor model without encoder speed adaptation Kp
descriere: Sets the proportional gain of the controller for speed adaptation without encoder.

descriere_scurta: Motor model without encoder speed adaptation Tn
descriere: Sets the integral time of the controller for speed adaptation without encoder

Displays estimated (speed) signals of the motor model. r1773[0]: Displays the estimated (mechanical) slip of the motor model. r1773[1]: Displays the estimated input speed of the motor model. Index: [0] = Slip speed estimated [1] = Speed estimated

descriere_scurta: Motor model offset voltage compensation alpha
descriere: Sets the offset voltage in the alpha direction; this compensates the offset voltages of the drive converter/inverter at low speeds. The value is valid for the rated (nominal) pulse frequency of the power unit.

descriere_scurta: Motor model offset voltage compensation beta
descriere: Sets the offset voltage in the beta direction; this compensates the offset voltages of the drive converter/inverter at low speeds. The value is valid for the rated (nominal) pulse frequency of the power unit.

Displays the internal status signals of the motor model: Index 0: Changeover ramp between current and voltage models Index 1: Changeover ramp for model tracking (encoderless induction motors only) Index 2: Changeover ramp for zero frequency range (encoderless induction motors only) Index 6: Transition ramp for EMF deviation at PLL input (encoderless PESM) Index: [0] = Changeover ramp motor model [1] = Changeover ramp model tracking [2] = Changeover ramp zero frequency encoderless ASM [3] = Reserved [4] = Reserved [5] = Reserved [6] = Changeover ramp motor model encoderless PESM
Sets the configuration for the adaptation circuit of the motor model. Induction motor (ASM): Rs, Lh, and offset compensation. Permanent magnet synchronous motor (PEM): kT
Sets the scaling for model fault feedback.
Sets the proportional gain for the Lh adaptation of the motor model for an induction motor (ASM).

descriere_scurta: Motor model Lh adaptation integral time
descriere: Sets the integral time for the Lh adaptation of the motor model for an induction motor (ASM).

descriere_scurta: Motor model Lh adaptation corrective value
descriere: Displays the corrective value for the Lh adaptation of the motor model for an induction motor (ASM).

descriere_scurta: Motor model kT adaptation integral time
descriere: Sets the integral time of the kT adaptation of the motor model for a permanent-magnet synchronous motor (PEM).

descriere_scurta: Motor model kT adaptation corrective value
descriere: Displays the corrective value of the kT adaptation of the motor model for a permanent-magnet synchronous motor (PEM).
Display and connector output for the actual converter switching frequency. Index: [0] = Actual [1] = Modulator minimum value
Defines the maximum modulation depth.
Sets the filter time constant of the DC link voltage used to calculate the modulation depth.

Sets the phase sequence reversal for the motor without setpoint change. If the motor does not rotate in the required direction, then the output phase sequence can be reversed using this parameter. This means that the direction of the motor is reversed without the setpoint being changed.
Sets the configuration for the motor data identification.
Displays the identified stator resistance. Index: [0] = Phase U [1] = Phase V [2] = Phase W
Displays the identified rotor time constant. Index: [0] = Phase U [1] = Phase V [2] = Phase W
Displays the identified total leakage inductance. Index: [0] = Phase U [1] = Phase V [2] = Phase W
Displays the nominal stator inductance identified.
Displays the nominal stator inductance identified for the 1st point of the saturation characteristic. Index: [0] = Phase U [1] = Phase V [2] = Phase W
Displays the nominal stator inductance identified for the 2nd point of the saturation characteristic. Index: [0] = Phase U [1] = Phase V [2] = Phase W
Displays the nominal stator inductance identified for the 3rd point of the saturation characteristic. Index: [0] = Phase U [1] = Phase V [2] = Phase W
Displays the nominal stator inductance identified for the 4th point of the saturation characteristic. Index: [0] = Phase U [1] = Phase V [2] = Phase W
Displays the identified IGBT threshold voltage. Index: [0] = Phase U [1] = Phase V [2] = Phase W
Displays the identified effective valve lockout time. Index: [0] = Phase U [1] = Phase V [2] = Phase W
Displays identified rotor resistance (on separately excited synchronous motors: damping resistance). Index: [0] = Phase U [1] = Phase V [2] = Phase W

descriere_scurta: Speed_ctrl_opt vibration test vibration frequency determined
descriere: Displays the vibration frequencies determined by the vibration test. Index: [0] = Frequency low [1] = Frequency high

descriere_scurta: Speed_ctrl_opt saturation characteristic maximum rotor flux
descriere: Sets the maximum flux setpoint to measure the saturation characteristic.
Sets the pole position identification technique.

descriere_scurta: Ang. commutation offset calibr. and PollD scaling
descriere: Sets the scaling for the runtime of the pole position identification technique in which the current is injected.

Displays the receive errors at the commissioning interface (USS, RS232). Index: [0] = Number of error-free telegrams [1] = Number of rejected telegrams [2] = Number of framing errors [3] = Number of overrun errors [4] = Number of parity errors [5] = Number of starting character errors [6] = Number of checksum errors [7] = Number of length errors

Sets the time values for the fieldbus interface. The following applies for MODBUS: p2024[0]: Maximum permissible telegram processing time of the MODBUS slave in which a reply is sent back to the MODBUS master. p2024[1]: Not relevant. p2024[2]: Telegram pause time (pause time between two telegrams). Index: [0] = Max. processing time [1] = Character delay time [2] = Telegram pause time

Displays the receive errors on the field bus interface (RS485). Index: [0] = Number of error-free telegrams [1] = Number of rejected telegrams [2] = Number of framing errors [3] = Number of overrun errors [4] = Number of parity errors [5] = Number of starting character errors [6] = Number of checksum errors [7] = Number of length errors
Displays the PROFIdrive PZD state.

Displays the PZD (actual values) with word format sent to the fieldbus controller. Index: [0] = PZD 1 [1] = PZD 2 [2] = PZD 3 [3] = PZD 4 [4] = PZD 5 [5] = PZD 6 [6] = PZD 7 [7] = PZD 8 [8] = PZD 9 [9] = PZD 10 [10] = PZD 11 [11] = PZD 12 [12] = PZD 13 [13] = PZD 14
Diagnostics display for the PROFIBUS interface. Index: [0] = Master bus address [1] = Master input total length bytes [2] = Master output total length bytes

Connector output to interconnect PZD (setpoints) with double word format received from the fieldbus controller. Index: [0] = PZD 1 + 2 [1] = PZD 2 + 3 [2] = PZD 3 + 4 [3] = PZD 4 + 5 [4] = PZD 5 + 6 [5] = PZD 6 + 7 [6] = PZD 7 + 8 [7] = PZD 8 + 9 [8] = PZD 9 + 10 [9] = PZD 10 + 11 [10] = PZD 11 + 12

descriere: Displays the PZD (actual values) with double word format sent to the fieldbus controller. Index: [0] = PZD 1 + 2 [1] = PZD 2 + 3 [2] = PZD 3 + 4 [3] = PZD 4 + 5 [4] = PZD 5 + 6 [5] = PZD 6 + 7 [6] = PZD 7 + 8 [7] = PZD 8 + 9 [8] = PZD 9 + 10 [9] = PZD 10 + 11 [10] = PZD 11 + 12 [11] = PZD 12 + 13 [12] = PZD 13 + 14

descriere_scurta: PROFIdrive diagnostics bus address PZD receive
descriere: Displays the PROFIBUS address of the sender from which the process data (PZD) is received. Index: [0] = PZD 1 [1] = PZD 2 [2] = PZD 3 [3] = PZD 4 [4] = PZD 5 [5] = PZD 6 [6] = PZD 7 [7] = PZD 8 [8] = PZD 9 [9] = PZD 10 [10] = PZD 11 [11] = PZD 12

descriere: Displays the PZD byte offset in the PROFIdrive receive telegram (controller output). Index: [0] = PZD 1 [1] = PZD 2 [2] = PZD 3 [3] = PZD 4 [4] = PZD 5 [5] = PZD 6 [6] = PZD 7 [7] = PZD 8 [8] = PZD 9 [9] = PZD 10 [10] = PZD 11 [11] = PZD 12

descriere_scurta: PROFIdrive diagnostics telegram offset PZD send
descriere: Displays the PZD byte offset in the PROFIdrive send telegram (controller input). Index: [0] = PZD 1 [1] = PZD 2 [2] = PZD 3 [3] = PZD 4 [4] = PZD 5 [5] = PZD 6 [6] = PZD 7 [7] = PZD 8 [8] = PZD 9 [9] = PZD 10 [10] = PZD 11 [11] = PZD 12 [12] = PZD 13 [13] = PZD 14

descriere_scurta: PROFIBUS diagnostics peer-to-peer data transfer addresses
descriere: Displays the addresses of the slaves (peers) where peer-to-peer data transfer has been configured via PROFIBUS.
